Name: (CP) Hitme's Spouse Portraits Reworked
Author: Hitme11
Description:
I found new 1.6 vanilla portraits are bland and boring because they looks exactly the same for everyone, which remind me of my passport photo (lol), so I remade them into portraits that I imagined they would want to take. For AT version, please check [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23151]it here,[/url] AT packs [b]are not up-to-date with the CP version[/b] until I find a way to reduce the workload.

[b]INSTRUCTION:[/b]
- Put [CP] Spouse Portraits Reworked into your Mods folder.
﻿- In config file or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] menu, choose:
﻿  ﻿- "Vanilla" or "Tonedown" under RecolorPortraits if you're using with other desaturated recolor, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20749]Universal Recolor[/url]
﻿﻿ - "Yes" or "No"  turn on/off replacing for individual portraits.
﻿ ﻿-  "No" or "Adarin" under "GenderbentBachelors" if you want to use with Adarin's genderbent bachelors mod.
﻿ ﻿- "Yes" or "No" under "SVEPortrait" to turn on/off replacing SVE portraits. You must install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]  for this to work.
﻿ ﻿- "Yes" or "No" under "SamMullet" to turn on/off replacing Mullet Sam, you must install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19330]Rosenbug's Sam Mullet Replacement[/url]﻿  for this to work.
﻿ ﻿- "Yes" or "No" under "RomRasPortrait" to turn on/off replacing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21607]Romanceable Rasmodius - Updated[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia[/url], need either to work.
﻿ ﻿- "Yes" or "No" under "RRRR Portrait" to turn on/off replacing RRRR Wizard, need SVE to work.
[b]﻿- More Portraits (4.0.0):[/b]
﻿ ﻿- These are [b]completely new painting[/b] and not vanilla spouse portraits, but share some similiar features. To obtain these, check the condition below or media section above for detail:
﻿ ﻿ ﻿[b]+ 'Queens Of Heart' (3x2 painting)[/b]: At least 14 hearts with Emily/Haley and 10 hearts with the other. Obtainable through Merchant with 45000 gold.
[b]﻿- Frame system[/b]:
﻿ ﻿- "Unique" will reset them to their original version, 'Seasonal Wood'  will load frame dynamically according to season, any other variables will load the respective frame for all seasons. (check the images for more information).

[b]CURRENT SUPPORTED MODS:[/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21607]Romanceable Rasmodius - Updated[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia
﻿[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19330]Rosenbug's Sam Mullet Replacement
[/url] ﻿﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]Jellonip's RRRR
[/url] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley (DSV)[/url]
﻿ ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21711]Hitme's Caroline Is Single[/url]
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20053]Hitme's Robin Is Single Revised[/url]
﻿- Adarin's Stardew Girl (built-in patch), simply turn on/off in the config.

For modded characters such as Rasmodius/Rasmodia, you need permission from the author of such mods, too.[/b]

[/color][color=#f4f4f4][b]PLANS: No plan for now, trying to fix the bug as I'm slowly back to modding (East Scarp?)[/b]
